text:
Kyle Connor has 20 goals in 26 games, a run the Jets' own channel billed as the fastest start to the season, and a four-game point streak with 18 points across his last ten. Our wins-added measure ranks him second among 567 skaters. Winnipeg is winning, and he is the reason more nights than not.

Here's the honest part. He has 20 goals on 14.0 expected goals (the quality of his chances), shooting 19% against 14% last season. The chances are genuine; he gets to the dangerous ice, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 66% of his entries last season. But a finishing rate like that rarely lasts a full year. Our numbers still project about 50 goals, which is a monster season even after the cooling. What to watch: his shot totals. He had two in each of his last three games, so the volume, not the finishing, is what keeps a run like this alive.
headline: Kyle Connor's 20 goals, and what will cool
